name: bioc-intelligence
title: Bioconductor Intelligence marts
description: Usage, publication, citation and grant metrics for Bioconductor packages. Query in DuckDB: ATTACH 'https://impact.bioconductor.org/data/bioc-intelligence.duckdb' AS bi (READ_ONLY).

resources.name: mart_ecosystem_downloads_yearly
resources.description: Downloads per year x repo x methodology era (2015 has a row per era).

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: methodology_era
fields.description: Download-stats collection era: 'pre_2015_10' or 'modern'. Bioconductor changed its methodology in Oct 2015; do not add counts across eras.

fields.name: sum_package_distinct_ips
fields.description: SUM of per-package monthly distinct IPs: a volume measure (one address x 50 packages counts 50 times), never a count of users. For project-level installs use mart_installer_downloads_monthly.

fields.name: downloads
fields.description: Raw download count (kept for reference; prefer distinct_ips).

fields.name: n_packages_with_downloads
fields.description: Packages with at least one download that year.

resources.name: mart_grant_attribution
resources.description: One row per NIH grant acknowledged by a paper linked to a package.

fields.name: grant_id
fields.description: NIH core project number, e.g. U24CA289073.

fields.name: agency
fields.description: NIH Institute/Center code.

fields.name: ic_name
fields.description: NIH Institute/Center name, e.g. National Human Genome Research Institute.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Parent award title (NIH RePORTER); a sub-project title only if no parent.

fields.name: fy_first
fields.description: First fiscal year RePORTER lists for the core project.

fields.name: fy_last
fields.description: Last fiscal year RePORTER lists for the core project.

fields.name: org_name
fields.description: Awardee organization on the latest parent-award row.

fields.name: n_packages_supported
fields.description: Distinct packages whose linked paper acknowledges the grant.

fields.name: n_citing_works
fields.description: Distinct works citing those papers (0 until cited-by runs).

fields.name: package_names
fields.description: The supported packages.

resources.name: mart_installer_downloads_monthly
resources.description: Project-level installs per month: distinct IPs of the installer package (BiocInstaller 2011-2018, then BiocVersion, which BiocManager installs). The Bioconductor convention for 'machines that installed Bioconductor'.

resources.name: mart_package_impact
resources.description: One row per package: downloads, linked publications, citations, RCR and grants.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo

fields.description: All-time raw downloads (spans both methodology eras).

fields.name: total_distinct_ips

resources.name: mart_package_work

fields.name: package_name

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.description: Work identifier: PMID when known, else DOI (OpenAlex ID is an enrichment handle).

fields.description: DOI, bare and lower-case (no https://doi.org/ prefix).

fields.name: pmid

fields.name: title
fields.description: Publication title.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year.

fields.name: journal
fields.description: Journal or venue.

fields.name: citation_count
fields.description: OpenAlex citation count.

fields.name: icite_rcr
fields.description: Relative Citation Ratio (NIH iCite): field- and time-normalized citation rate; 1.0 = NIH-wide average.

fields.name: nih_percentile
fields.description: NIH iCite percentile of the RCR among NIH-funded papers (0-100); 90 = top decile.

fields.name: apt
fields.description: NIH iCite Approximate Potential to Translate: predicted probability (0-1) that the paper is later cited by a clinical article.

fields.name: is_clinical
fields.description: NIH iCite flag: the paper is itself a clinical article.

fields.name: citations_per_year
fields.description: NIH iCite citations per year since publication.

fields.name: is_preprint
fields.description: Venue looks like a preprint server (journal name contains 'rxiv').

fields.name: is_retracted
fields.description: OpenAlex retraction flag.

fields.name: n_patent_citations
fields.description: Distinct patents citing the work (Reliance on Science); 0 = none found, empty = no OpenAlex id or not yet enriched.

fields.name: match_method
fields.description: How the link was made: doi (the package's own DOI), citation_file (CITATION / CITATION.cff), description_doi (a DOI in Description, sometimes a dependency's paper), title_search, manual.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Link confidence, 0-1 (doi 1.0, citation_file 0.9, description_doi 0.8).

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role of the paper for the package, e.g. primary.

views.name: package_pubs_confident
views.description: Package-paper links made by DOI or CITATION file only (drops description_doi and title_search). Use for grant reporting.
views.sql: SELECT * FROM mart_package_work WHERE match_method IN ('doi', 'citation_file')

views.name: downloads_modern_era
views.description: Yearly downloads per repo, modern collection methodology only (Oct 2015 on).

views.name: ecosystem_yearly
views.description: Download VOLUME per year summed across repos and packages, one row per methodology era (never mix eras). sum_package_distinct_ips is not a count of users; see installs_yearly for that.
views.sql: SELECT year, methodology_era, SUM(sum_package_distinct_ips) AS sum_package_distinct_ips, SUM(downloads) AS downloads, SUM(n_packages_with_downloads) AS n_packages_with_downloads FROM mart_ecosystem_downloads_yearly GROUP BY year, methodology_era ORDER BY year, methodology_era

views.name: installs_yearly
views.description: Machines installing Bioconductor per year: distinct IPs of the installer package (BiocInstaller to 2018, BiocVersion since), summed over months. The Bioconductor convention for project-level usage; one row per methodology era.
views.sql: SELECT year, methodology_era, SUM(installer_distinct_ips) AS installer_distinct_ips FROM mart_installer_downloads_monthly GROUP BY year, methodology_era ORDER BY year, methodology_era

views.name: package_impact_ranked
views.description: package_impact ordered by rank within repo on trailing-12-month distinct IPs.
views.sql: SELECT * FROM mart_package_impact ORDER BY repo, usage_rank_in_repo
